Detailed Description

Provides a strict weak ordering of chords by their pitches, independent of g.

This must be used in all std:: containers that require ordering (e.g. std::set) to ensure that the ordering is stable and not affected by tiny floating point noise. The ordering is determined first by number of voices, then by pitches in voice order. NaNs are considered greater than any number, and equal to each other.
